tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders should follow and abide to all the terms & conditions maintained in the bid document
Bidder should fill the tender document and then along with the seal & signature bidder has to upload the whole tender document
Bidder should quote his service charges to HAMUl and all its units mentioned in this tender
Bidders are requested to go through the tender notification before processing EMD
Managing Director/Management of Hassan Co-operative Milk Producers Societies Union Limited, reserves the right to accept either all the tender or reject all the tender without giving any reasons
The quantity of persons maintained above is tentative, it may increase or decrease

Bidder should use action button to view & quote the relevant financial classification/Bifurcation details with tax part & other for all the tender through online compulsorily during uploading commercial bid.

Hassan Milk Union comes under essential services. HAMUL is handling MILK collected from Lakhs of Milk producing farmers, which is highly perishable commodity it is of paramount importance to ensure timely processing of the same. In order to ensure timely supply of goods and services and maintain continuous production, the technically qualified MSMEs shall submit E.M.D amount (either DD/RTGS/NEFT to HAMUL in the name of Managing Director,HCMPSUL., Hassan) prescribed in tender within 3 days of intimation from this office, in favour of Managing Director, Hassan Co-operative Milk Producers Societies Union Ltd, Hassan. Otherwise the bids of such organization will not be considered for commercial opening & Technically qualified bidders who have submitted the E.M.D will be considered for commercial opening.

Bidder should quote service charge in percentage on total bill excluding service tax for all 5 items on KPP Portal. Further the L1 will be considered based on the weighted average of all the items after calculating the salary of all together for 2 years
